name: Pallyy
tagline: Pallyy is a social media management tool designed for agencies and creators, offering scheduling, analytics, and inbox management for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other platforms. Its AI features assist with caption writing and hashtag suggestions to speed up content creation.
